Thanks for contributing to the improvement of `posix_ipc`!

If you think you've found a bug but you're not sure, or if you have a usage question, consider asking on the mailing list instead of creating an issue: https://groups.io/g/python-posix-ipc/topics

If you still want to file a bug, include basic platform info (Linux, Mac, etc.) and maybe the output from `uname -a`.
